response.sql:
WITH operator_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as scan_count,
    AVG(gbsize / spanmin) as avg_gb_per_min
  FROM scans
  WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY crewref
),
simple_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) as simple_avg_gb_per_min
  FROM operator_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(os.scan_count) as avg_scans_per_operator,
  AVG(os.avg_gb_per_min) as avg_gb_per_min_these_ops,
  AVG(os.avg_gb_per_min) - sa.simple_avg_gb_per_min as avg_excess
FROM operator_stats os
CROSS JOIN simple_avg sa
WHERE os.avg_gb_per_min > sa.simple_avg_gb_per_min

assumptions.assumption: "Missing values are ignored" means scans with NULL gbsize or NULL spanmin are excluded entirely from calculations

"The simple average of that figure across all operators" refers to the unweighted arithmetic mean of each operator's average (i.e., average of the operator-level averages, not weighted by scan count per operator)

alternatives.interpretation: "The simple average across all operators" is the overall weighted average—computed as avg(gbsize / spanmin) across all scans from all operators (equivalent to the average weighted by each operator's number of scans)

CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE os.avg_gb_per_min > oa.overall_gb_per_min
